pages.text: Today, they would hang lanterns in the alley. Grandpa gave them an armful of colored paper.
Gugu wanted a huge lantern for the alley. "I will use all the paper."
Gugu hugged every sheet. Nono and Kiki had nothing before them.
Gugu curved a big sheet upright. Sticking one side made the other pop open.
Gugu pressed with a foot. It still kept opening.
The paper crumpled. The lantern collapsed.
Evening came. Not one lantern hung in the alley.
Grandpa Badger asked, "How many hands do you need to hold it?"
Gugu shared the colored paper. Nono held one side, and Kiki glued it.
Three big lanterns hung side by side in the alley. Grandpa lit them, making the alley bright.
